description: Recorded run setup and summarized results; historical paths identify original artifacts.

items.evidence_level: HTTP variants plus kernel prototypes; distinguish in report
items.experiments: fixed socket files; provided-buffer multishot receive; receive buffer size
items.outcome: HTTP fixed-file and larger-buffer variants tested and parked; provided-buffer multishot receive completed as a TCP prototype, HTTP integration remains open.

items.experiments: vectored header/body send; bounded stream coalescing; large-payload zero-copy send
items.outcome: Vectored sends and safe bounded stream batching retained. SEND_ZC HTTP prototype passed correctness checks but all local notifications copied and total server-core activity rose; parked locally.

items.experiments: direct header writes and common-status encoding; complete response template
items.outcome: Direct general header writes retained. Complete built-in template tested and parked: little incremental whole-server gain.

items.evidence_level: HTTP variants plus kernel prototypes; distinguish in report
items.experiments: multishot accept; larger accept backlog; direct descriptors
items.outcome: Ordinary/multishot accept and backlog 128/4096 tested at 30k/s and through pressure/recovery. Backlog reduces failures but raises queueing. Direct descriptors completed as a corrected TCP probe. Defaults retained.

items.experiments: active-slot timer scan (separate parser allocation already tested)
items.outcome: Active-slot scan retained. Refined idle measurements make a timer wheel unjustified locally; whole buffer memory remains open.

items.experiments: specialized access formatting; owner-only log counters
items.outcome: Specialized access formatter retained with general fallback. Owner-only logger counters tested and parked. Bounded logger drops reported explicitly.

items.experiments: bounded pipelined response coalescing and fragmented-input workload
items.outcome: Bounded public pipeline output batching retained with complete-head guard and explicit pre-receive flush. Fragmented-client CPU tradeoff recorded. Broken flush mutant fails new preservation test.

items.evidence_level: HTTP variants plus kernel prototypes; distinguish in report
items.experiments: local veth network; same/cross-cache placement; worker scaling; scoped busy-poll probe
items.outcome: Local veth same/cross-L3, GRO on/off, one/two/four workers completed. Socket and ring busy-poll APIs accepted but NAPI ID 0 prevents an effective queue test. Physical NIC work unavailable by user constraint.

items.experiments: SQPOLL with its additional CPU counted
items.outcome: HTTP SQPOLL variant tested with an observed dedicated poll core. Latency improvement costs a fully busy additional core; parked for default.

already_tested: scalar/vector field scans and complete-head parser
separate parser allocation and idle pool cost
large echo, stream, overload and cancellation correctness
record.physical_limit: No remote load generator. Local veth is available but shares one kernel and cannot establish physical NIC, IRQ, RSS, interrupt coalescing or hardware zero-copy receive costs.

failed_candidates.fixed_files: 44/46 TCP tests passed; startup fails under descriptor limit and many large worker pools

kernel_prototypes.multishot_receive: Completed loopback and veth TCP probes with validated bytes; no HTTP integration or concurrent HTTP pool-exhaustion claim.
kernel_prototypes.direct_accept: Completed corrected local TCP probe, excluding asymmetric per-connection diagnostic overhead; parked.
kernel_prototypes.zero_copy_send: HTTP prototype and TCP probes complete; all observed loopback and veth notifications report copying; physical crossover remains unmeasured.
kernel_prototypes.socket_and_ring_busy_poll: Both APIs accepted 50 us; incoming NAPI ID remains 0 across loopback/veth. Effective hardware queue polling unavailable here.

documentation_only_difference.src/application/Exchange.zig: Clarify borrowed producer-fragment lifetime and batching; exact previous documentation restored in memory to verify the measured source hash.
